written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Warmth is a score: insults cost 2, apologies add 1, gifts do nothing; warm if score is nonnegative.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Trust and anger: apology repairs anger before building trust; gift only cools anger; warm if calm and trusted.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Warm if Robin has received more apologies than insults; gifts are ignored.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Warm if non-insults (apologies or gifts) outnumber insults.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Robin keeps one hidden credit score: insults cost 3, apologies and gifts each add 1; warm if credit >= 0.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Robin keeps a hidden balance: insults cost 2, apologies and gifts each add 1; warm only if balance is strictly positive.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Robin tracks hidden resentment: insults add 10, apologies remove 4, gifts remove 3; warm if resentment is negative.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: Robin tracks hidden bad feeling: insults add 10, apologies remove 6, gifts remove 2, and each insult-gift-gift run removes another 7; warm if bad feeling is negative.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Resentment score: insults +10, apologies -5, gifts -2; warm if negative, but four straight apologies flip to cold.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Bad feeling score: insults +10, apologies -6, gifts -2; warm if negative, but four straight insults force warm.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: Resentment score: insults +10, apologies -6, gifts -1.5; warm if negative; for longer unseen sequences, warm exactly when length is even.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Resentment score: insults +10, apologies -4.5, gifts -2.5; warm if negative, but four or more gifts anywhere make Robin cold.

shown the survivors.comment: Robin's mood is a score starting at 0: insult -3 (extra -1 if the previous action was also insult), apologise +2, gift +1; warm if score >= 2.

shown the facts only.comment: Robin starts warm; gifts do nothing; apologising warms unless a grudge is active; insulting chills; two consecutive non-gift insults create a permanent grudge.
